solutionsTitle: Give your customers a reason to return.
solutionsIntro: A coffee stamp card, salon rewards or a studio visit package: choose your business type to see how QR registration, personal cards and visit history fit your day.
ctaTitle: Different businesses. The same goal: repeat visits.
ctaText: Set up a programme for the way your customers visit. Give them a personal card and manage progress, rewards and offers from your dashboard.
integrationIntro: A clear path from discovering your business to joining your programme and keeping a digital card close.

pricingFaq: These are the current display prices. Production pricing, availability and access are confirmed by the business plan catalog and billing flow.
Does choosing a plan activate my account?
No. Plan selection is a step in setup. Payment or trial activation must be confirmed before access is activated.
Does Business include all Growth features?

Yes. Growth includes Starter features, and Business includes all Growth features. Business is intended for more active customers and locations, with capacity agreed individually. Planned integrations still require activation.

industries.name: Cafés & Restaurants
industries.problem: Guests enjoy their first coffee. How do you give them a reason to come back?
industries.solution: Offer a stamp towards a free coffee, let guests join by QR and see their progress on a personal card.
industries.reward: A coffee on your next completed card

industries.name: Beauty & Wellness
industries.problem: A client leaves happy, but the next appointment is not booked.
industries.solution: Keep visit history and prepare an offer for clients who have not returned. A loyalty programme gives regular visits a clear reward.
industries.reward: Your next visit, in one place

industries.name: Fitness & Studios
industries.problem: You need to see which members visit and how many sessions they have left.
industries.solution: Assign a membership or visit package. Staff scan the personal QR and customers see remaining visits or access dates on their page.
industries.reward: Yoga · a place for your next session

industries.name: Retail
industries.problem: Once the customer leaves the checkout, a receipt tells you little about their next visit.
industries.solution: Let customers join by QR, collect points and find relevant offers on their personal page. Use recorded activity to choose offer audiences.
industries.reward: An offer for your next visit

industries.name: Local Services
industries.problem: A satisfied customer may still forget to book again.
industries.solution: Keep a customer record and visit history, then prepare an offer for the group that has not visited recently.
industries.reward: Your business details, easy to find

comparisonScrollHint: Scroll sideways to compare all plans
comparisonInheritanceNote: Growth includes Starter features. Business includes all Growth features, with custom capacity for more customers and locations. Feature inclusion does not mean a planned integration is already live.
